subject.title: feat: add publisher follow controls and discovery

question: Should ClawHub accept publisher-follow controls and discovery as a core ClawHub feature after the base follow API lands, or pause this stacked follow-up until the API contract and proof are accepted?
rationale: This adds new user-facing discovery behavior and private follow-state API surface, and the final direction depends on maintainer acceptance of the follow graph stack rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Land base API first
options.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 to clear proof, docs, and generated-artifact readiness, then rebase and review this UI/discovery slice.

options.title: Review stack together
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally review the API, controls, and notification PRs as one feature stack while owning the private follow-state boundary together.

options.title: Pause follow controls
options.body: If the base follow API direction is not accepted, pause or close this follow-up rather than carrying a conflicting stacked branch.

recommendation.title: Land base API first
recommendation.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 to clear proof, docs, and generated-artifact readiness, then rebase and review this UI/discovery slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main provenance for the API route constants and baseline creator/profile surfaces points to Patrick Erichsen.
